verses.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!

xrefs.text: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.

verses.text: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!

xrefs.text: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ— not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
